<function name="CopyContents" parent="DIconLayout" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Copies the contents (Child elements) of another <page>DIconLayout</page> to itself.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="from" type="Panel"><page>DIconLayout</page> to copy from.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
